title: OTHMODE core operating discipline
context: The two behavioural rules every Mythos execution path already follows, packaged so a provider prompt, a skill, or a future evolution can reference them as one validated unit instead of rediscovering them. Created on real need: the OTHMODE Phase 2/AUTH releases applied both rules end-to-end and their reuse surface (executor prompt template, postflight skill, validation runner) is now concrete.
instructions: When executing: a task whose provider holds execution authority waits for quota (WAITING_FOR_QUOTA) and never falls back across the authority line. When validating: select targeted suites from projects/meta/test-impact-map.json, establish the baseline failure count before blaming a change, run the full suite only when shared code changed, report exact counts — 0 new failures is the floor.
